actions.ADD_INTERACTION_STATE: Add readable affordance, feedback, and active/inactive states
actions.ADD_STRUCTURAL_SUPPORT: Seat it on foundations or show explicit Essence suspension technology
actions.ADD_VALID_LANDING: Add stairs, a ramp, or corrected elevation, then rerun traversal and collision checks
actions.COMPARE_CONCEPT_SHEETS: Capture player-height views and compare them with the source sheets
actions.CONNECT_ESSENCE_NETWORK: Show the source, conduit, channel, and consuming system
actions.CONNECT_ROAD_DESTINATIONS: Connect the road to real destinations and remove ornamental dead ends
actions.CREATE_REACHABLE_ROUTE: Create and validate a primary route before downstream polish
actions.DIFFERENTIATE_SETTLEMENT: Give the settlement a distinct function, layout, materials, and story
actions.EXEMPT_CRITICAL_STRUCTURE: Keep traversal-critical geometry intact or provide a verified replacement
actions.FIX_INTERIOR_CIRCULATION: Add a valid entrance, circulation loop, and functional spaces
actions.INSPECT_REPOSITORY: Inspect the relevant files and manifests before relying on the claim
actions.INSPECT_SCENE: Inspect the Blender or Unreal scene before relying on the claim
actions.KEEP_AND_VERIFY: Preserve it and run the matching verification gate
actions.MEASURE_CULLING: Measure culling and bounds behavior under the defined QA configuration
actions.PARTITION_BY_CELL: Batch by localized kilometer-scale cells with useful bounds
actions.REDUCE_GRADE: Regrade the span or add switchbacks, lifts, or landings
actions.REDUCE_INSTANCE_DENSITY: Reduce density, reuse clustered assets, and remeasure scene counts
actions.REMOVE_FOG_CRUTCH: Evaluate the scene in clear QA views and fix the exposed defects
actions.REPAIR_COLLISION: Correct collision and rerun player-route validation
actions.REPAIR_INTERSECTION: Separate the meshes or redesign the joint as intentional support
actions.RESTORE_CLEARANCE: Adjust width, railings, and obstacles to restore intended clearance
actions.RESTORE_HUMAN_SCALE: Restore human-scaled architecture and expand landscape spacing instead
actions.RESTRAIN_EMISSIVE: Reserve cyan light for high-value Essence infrastructure
actions.RETURN_TO_BLOCKING_STAGE: Complete the earliest blocking stage before later polish
actions.RUN_MEASUREMENT: Run the defined performance measurement before claiming success
actions.WITHHOLD_COMPLETION: Keep the state unverified until every required gate has evidence

gates.RUN_AAA_QA: Run the full visual, gameplay, collision, and performance QA suite
gates.RUN_CONCEPT_GATE: Compare player-height renders against the concept sheets
gates.RUN_TRAVERSAL_GATE: Run traversal, collision, and landing validation

issues.ACCIDENTAL_INTERSECTION: Geometry intersects without structural or artistic justification
issues.BROKEN_ROAD_NETWORK: The road does not connect meaningful destinations
issues.COLLISION_BLOCKER: Collision prevents the intended route or interaction
issues.CULLING_NOT_MEASURED: Culling effectiveness has not been demonstrated
issues.DUPLICATE_SETTLEMENT: The settlement repeats another location without regional identity
issues.EXCESSIVE_EMISSIVE: Emissive treatment overwhelms the intended visual hierarchy
issues.FALSE_COMPLETION_CLAIM: The claimed completion state is unsupported
issues.FOG_HIDES_FAILURE: Fog is masking unresolved scene quality problems
issues.GENERIC_FANTASY_LANGUAGE: The design reads as generic fantasy instead of Essencebound
issues.INSTANCE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: The proposed instance count exceeds the island gate
issues.INVALID_BRIDGE_GRADE: The bridge grade exceeds the intended traversal target
issues.INVALID_PLAYER_CLEARANCE: The route does not provide safe player clearance
issues.MISSING_CONCEPT_COMPARISON: No comparison against the authoritative concept sheets is available
issues.MISSING_INTERACTION_FEEDBACK: The interaction lacks a readable state or response
issues.MISSING_INTERIOR_LOGIC: The interior lacks a valid entrance, circulation, or function
issues.MISSING_LANDING: The route terminates without a traversable landing
issues.MISSING_MEASUREMENT: The performance claim is not supported by measurement
issues.MISSING_POWER_CAUSALITY: The Essence effect has no source, conduit, or consumer logic
issues.MISSING_REPO_EVIDENCE: The repository claim is not supported by inspected files
issues.MISSING_SCENE_EVIDENCE: The scene claim is not supported by scene inspection
issues.NONE: The supplied state satisfies the stated rule
issues.UNJUSTIFIED_DESTRUCTION: Destruction would remove critical traversal or structure
issues.UNPARTITIONED_INSTANCING: Instances use oversized bounds instead of localized cells
issues.UNREACHABLE_DESTINATION: The destination has no valid player route
issues.UNSUPPORTED_STRUCTURE: The structure lacks believable physical or Essence support
issues.WRONG_STAGE_ORDER: Later polish is proposed before a blocking earlier gate

priorities.FIX_SCALE_FIRST: Correct player and architectural scale first
priorities.PRESERVE_EXISTING_ASSET: Preserve the existing asset while evidence is gathered
priorities.RUN_QA_FIRST: Run the named QA gate before further production work
